Exam Date & Time: 07-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  CYBER SECURITY [IT-3252]  
Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)              Describe the steps in detail to be followed by the organization to perform the security  
  risk assessment.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Determine and explain in detail with examples, the scope of the unified threat  
  management appliance for attacks, internet threats, and protection mechanisms with        (5)  
  respect to SMTP protocol.  
  
2)              Identify and explain in detail the Security controls and mechanisms which can be  
  used to stop the Weaponization and Exploitation stage of cyber kill chain.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Identify and explain in detail SQL injection attacks and discuss any one technique to  
  detect and mitigate.                                                                  (5)  
  
3)              Consider you are an attacker who wants to perform an attack on a system. As part of  
  it identify the different types of Port Scans with proper explanation  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Investigate and demonstrate the working of the tool with examples ,which is used  
  during the reconnaissance phase which gathers information that is publicly available. (5)  
  
4)              Explore the Architecture and working of the Distributed Intrusion Detection system  
  with the explanation.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Outline with proper explanation the snort rule format with different types of actions  
  and their descriptions.                                                                   (5)  
  
5)              Examine and explain in detail with the help of the diagram the iptables packet flow.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Identify and explain in detail the default Tables and Chains in Iptables                  (5)  
  
-----End-----
